name: Median holder-balance expansion
hypothesis: Buy positive price momentum when the median balance change of a fixed eligible holder cohort rises.
spec: Setup: Broad balance growth may be stronger than a growing wallet count alone. Entry: Buy positive price momentum when the median balance change of a fixed eligible holder cohort rises. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when cohort balance growth reverses or price support fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time holder balances and wallet clustering (on-chain, not connected)
